params.prompt:
Create exactly FOUR complete full-body Archive Knight upper-attack poses in a clean 2 columns x 2 rows source sheet. References 1 and 2 are absolute identity authorities. Preserve exactly: faceless ivory crested helm; cyan visor slit; enormous open broken-archive-arch LEFT pauldron with dark-indigo center and cyan inner seam; small RIGHT shoulder; violet sternum core; porcelain plates; deep-plum joints; short rigid split tabards; heavy boots; ONE cyan-edged archive blade physically integrated along the RIGHT forearm at constant length. The weapon is part of the gauntlet: never detach it, hold it by a handle, duplicate it, move it to the other arm, or turn it into a loose sword. Never mirror, swap, omit or redesign asymmetrical features.

Screen-right three-quarter camera, stable scale/light/baseline. Pose order: 1 fast LEFT pommel jab while right blade remains guarded and attached; 2 armored RIGHT shoulder drive led by the broken-arch pauldron while blade remains tucked along forearm; 3 heavy downward cleave performed by swinging the entire RIGHT forearm and its attached blade; 4 wide cleave follow-through with the attached blade low and outward, one restrained cyan-violet edge streak hugging the blade only. Strong fighting-game silhouettes, full body visible, generous clearance.

PROJECT MANNEQUIN STYLE LOCK: controlled dark contours, broad cel shading, clean highlights, fighting anatomy, polished anime finish. Perfectly uniform pure white background. No grid, text, labels, border, floor, shadows, scenery, extra figures/limbs, loose/second blade, shield, cape, floating parts, cropped crest/blade/feet, overlap, photorealism, PBR, rust, grime, microtexture, painterly blur.
